<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Arial" ALIGN="center"><B>CERTIFICATE OF LIMITED PARTNERSHIP </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Arial" ALIGN="center"><B>OF

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Arial">The undersigned, desiring to form a limited partnership pursuant to the Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act, 6 <U>Del. C.</U> &#167;&#167; <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17-101</FONT> <U>et</U> <U>seq</U>., hereby certifies as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Arial">1. <U>Name</U>. The name of the limited partnership
formed hereby is Blackstone Infrastructure Strategies (TE) L.P. (the &#8220;<U>Partnership</U>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Arial">2. <U>Registered Office; Registered
Agent</U>. The address of the Partnership&#8217;s registered office in the State of Delaware is c/o Corporation Service Company, 251 Little Falls Drive, Wilmington, Delaware 19808. The name and address of the Partnership&#8217;s registered agent for
service of process on the Partnership is Corporation Service Company, 251 Little Falls Drive, Wilmington, Delaware 19808. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Arial">3. <U>General
Partner</U>. The name and mailing address of the sole general partner of the Partnership is as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Arial">Blackstone Infrastructure Strategies

York 10154 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Arial">IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned has executed this Certificate of Limited Partnership of Blackstone Infrastructure Strategies (TE)
